title: Vendor Invoices page shows Vendor, Invoice date, Date received, Received by
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Parts pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Parts area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Parts area and go to the Vendor Invoices page.
2. Look at the filter buttons shown above the vendor invoices table.
expected: 1. The Vendor Invoices page shows four filter buttons: Vendor, Invoice date, Date received and Received by.
2. The table shows the columns: Work Order, Invoice Number, Order Number, Received By, Vendor Name, Date Received, Invoice Date, Due Date, Total Cost and Note.
3. There is no New button on this page (only the search and filter icons).
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11884-16885 (Parts filters); design-notes.md §B.5 #7
notes: Design-only (chip + column presence). Option lists and apply behaviour pending Branko's PRD.
